pairing_policy: For each repetition, all observation-noise levels share the latent training trajectories and standard-normal position-error arrays from the existing paired sweep. Strong FD-OLS uses exactly the observed training arrays used by weak LASSO and weak OLS.
evaluation_policy: Evaluate every frozen strong-form coefficient vector on the same latent held-out trajectory and species-balanced drift metric used by the weak-method sweep.
failure_policy: Retain every prespecified repetition, rank deficiency, nonfinite coefficient, and missing metric. Do not rerun to improve a result.
manuscript_policy: Add strong FD-OLS only to the observation-noise panel of the predator--prey robustness figure; retain the weak-method-only time-step and prey-count panels.
